title: Arc Pro B70 · kernel microbench · ingest, exl3xpu expert kernels (Qwen3.8-Flash-Next + GLM-5.3-Flash shapes), launch/sync
hardware_note: Arc Pro B70 0000:84:00.0 only (slot B: renderD130 via /dev/dri/by-path, ZE_AFFINITY_MASK=0, 1 xpu device visible), --cpuset-cpus 44-47 --memory 32g --memory-swap 32g --device-read-bps /dev/md127:6gb (io.max 9:127 rbps=6442450944), SVM keys on (NEOReadDebugKeys, EnableSharedSystemUsmSupport, EnableRecoverablePageFaults); xpu lock xpu-0000_84_00_0 via freetoken-exl3 bench/xpu_run.sh
contended_note: slot A (RTX 3090 81:00.0) ran the P003 glm53 v4-nvme smoke container for the whole run; H2D was 23.9 GB/s vs 26.7 idle (N106), so link-bound numbers are ~10% low
method: docs/b70-microbench.md; scripts in docs/b70-microbench/bench (ingest.py, experts.py, sync.py, run.sh, guard.sh); raw JSON in docs/b70-microbench/raw. Kernel timings are XPU events around back-to-back calls that rotate through 2 layers of experts (1,024 Qwen / 576 GLM), so no call finds its weights in the 24 MB L2.

nvme_notes: O_DIRECT into L0 USM host memory fails: OSError(14, 'Bad address')
O_DIRECT into L0 USM host (sycl::malloc_host) fails with EFAULT; ring lives in memfd THP

meta.blobs: real GLM layer 3 experts 0..15, cycled over 576 slots (key k holds expert k % 16)
meta.splits_note: the split scan picked gu 4 / dn 4, but the reference check that follows it resets to 8/16, so every GLM case row ran at gu 8 / dn 16 (raw meta says [4, 4]); 4/4 is 3-6% faster in the scan (M1 0.1696 vs 0.1753, M4 0.6698 vs 0.7092, M8 1.3323 vs 1.3906 ms) but has no MR=4 gate|up instance (grouped M4 fails with 'unsupported MR/P 4/4')

experts_glm_random_blobs.note: same cases on random trellis blobs at gu 4 / dn 4 (outputs NaN); per-case ms ratio random/real: median 0.99, range 0.84-1.5 (contention noise); grouped M4 rows fail (no GU(4,4) instance)

fits.method: least squares over the 'distinct' / cached_b2b series (unique experts per layer call vs ms); per_extra_token = (shared(M) - distinct(1)) / (topk * (M - 1)); zero-copy per_expert = mixed-call slope per host expert + VRAM per_expert

guard: journalctl -k (since 12:05) before/after every job: no Completion-Wait timeout, Link Down, Card not present, reboot-needed, pciehp, non-corrected AER, or xe 84:00.0 reset/wedge lines; no D-state khugepaged/kcompactd. Background corrected AER (root ports c0:03.x, NVMe c5-c8, 81/82/83) ran ~100-130/min before and during the run, unchanged by it.
quality: n/a (microbench). GLM-shape MoE kernel vs exl3xpu_C.linear per projection on real layer-3 experts: rel L2 err 0.0012 for splits 8/16, 4/4, 16/16; tier outputs (VRAM / USM / SVM) bit-identical for both models
